# Mochi Collective

> Mochi Collective is a brand-experience, program design and events agency based in Singapore, working across Southeast Asia. We design brand activations, conferences, sponsor programs and community/membership initiatives with impact measurement baked in — every event and program ends with proof, not just a recap. Legal entity: Mochi Collective Pte. Ltd. (Singapore, UEN 202538712H).

Tagline: Make it worth talking about.
Contact: hello@mochicollective.com (typically replies inside 72 hours on weekdays)
Book a discovery call: https://zcal.co/mochicollective/consultation

## What we do (five practices, one operating system)

- Brand Experiences: launches, activations, immersive moments — engineered to over-index on press, social and word of mouth, and measured after the doors close.
- Impact Measurement: pre/during/post tracking of behaviour, sentiment and impact against the metric your stakeholder, sponsor or board cares about.
- Conferences & Events: conferences, summits and corporate events run against the metric that paid for them.
- Sponsor Programs: sponsorship packages built around measurable outcomes, so renewals start from proof.
- Community & Membership: salons, dinners and recurring formats that compound, with retention tracked.

## How we work

Three steps, every engagement: Strategy (start with the metric, not the moodboard) → Design (build the experience around the proof model) → Proof (a report any stakeholder can read). The Service Concierge returns a program shape, budget reality check and runway typically inside 72 weekday hours.

## Who we serve

Marketing, brand and events leaders, and new brand founders in Singapore and Southeast Asia who need their events and programs to prove their worth to a stakeholder, sponsor or board.
